prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1328; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a wrist injury that is consistent in type and mechanism with the force of the impact described. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to the same area is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered over thirteen visits and followed a typical course: immobilization, pain management, progressive range-of-motion and strengthening exercises, and serial reassessment. Visit frequency tapered as the patient's function and pain improved, and the final visits were directed at returning to daily activities. Billing records reflect single, distinct charges for each encounter, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the last evaluation the fracture was documented as healing appropriately, and the patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with follow-up as needed.
